typedChecks.sourceText: Male or female participants must be at least 18 years old or the legal age of majority in their country, whichever is greater.
Have locally unresectable advanced or metastatic histologically or cytologically confirmed squamous NSCLC.
ECOG performance status (PS) score of 0 or 1.

Participants who are neurologically, clinically and radiologically stable >=2 weeks after definitive treatment for brain metastases and/or participants with small (sum of all brain lesions: <=3 cm), asymptomatic, incidental, untreated brain metastases may participate in this trial as long as they meet certain criteria as defined in the protocol.
Hemoglobin <9 g/dL.
Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) <1,500 mm^3.
PLT count <100 x 10^3/mm^3.
Total bilirubin greater than (>) 1.0×ULN except for participants with Gilbert's syndrome with serum bilirubin <=3×ULN or if concurrent conjugated bilirubin <=ULN.

Creatinine clearance (CrCl) <30 milliliters per minute (mL/min); the Cockcroft-Gault formula is used to calculate CrCl (using ideal body weight for obese participants and actual body weight for non-obese participants).
